'''Kron Thon''' was a criminal operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. While cruising on a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] arranged for the [[Yarno]] table to be rigged.
